name: SPT Fika Dedicated Client
author: maxomatic458.dev@gmail.com
startup: ./pre-check.sh && cd Dedicated-Client && (tail -f BepInEx/LogOutput.log & PID=$!; wine {{EFT_BINARY}} -token="{{PROFILE_ID}}" -config="{'BackendUrl':'{{BACKEND_URL}}', 'Version':'live'}" -batchmode -nographics; kill $PID)

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SPT/Fika Dedicated (Headless) Client

GREEN='\033[0;32m'
cd ${HOME}

echo -e "${GREEN}installing dotnet"

# install dotnet and add sources
apt update && apt install -yq dotnet-sdk-${DOTNET_VERSION}
dotnet nuget add source https://nuget.bepinex.dev/v3/index.json

# download and build the fika plugins

mkdir tmp
cd tmp

# build the fika plugin

echo -e "${GREEN}building the fika plugin"

git clone https://github.com/project-fika/Fika-Plugin -b ${FIKA_PLUGIN_BRANCH}
cd Fika-Plugin
dotnet build --configuration Release



cd ${HOME}/tmp

# build the fika dedicated plugin

echo -e "${GREEN}building the fika dedicated plugin"

git clone https://github.com/project-fika/Fika-Dedicated -b ${FIKA_DEDICATED_BRANCH}
cd Fika-Dedicated
dotnet build --configuration Release

# setup directories

cd ${HOME}
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Dedicated-Client/BepInEx/plugins



# script that runs before the game runs, to check if required live files
# are present

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.wine/drive_c/live

# registry files stolen from https://github.com/zhliau/fika-headless-docker
# i should probably find the relevant keys and include them here and just append them
# to the default registry.

echo -e "${GREEN}importing custom registry files"

apt install -yq curl

cd /mnt/server/.wine
curl -o system.reg https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhliau/fika-headless-docker/22ea3d450010f44edcae3efec6f671040b9d98c5/data/reg/system.reg
curl -o user.reg https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhliau/fika-headless-docker/22ea3d450010f44edcae3efec6f671040b9d98c5/data/reg/user.reg

echo -e "${GREEN}imported custom registry files"

cd ${HOME}

echo '#!/bin/bash
RED="\033[0;31m" 
if [ ! -f ./.wine/drive_c/live/ConsistencyInfo ]; then
echo -e "${RED}The live EFT files are not present, put them in /home/container/.wine/drive_c/live (EscapeFromTarkov_Data is not required)"
exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f ./Dedicated-Client/EscapeFromTarkov.exe ]; then
echo -e "${RED}The SPT Files are not present, put them in /home/container/Dedicated-Client"
exit 1
fi
' > pre-check.sh

chmod +x pre-check.sh

mv pre-check.sh /mnt/server
mv tmp/Fika-Plugin/Fika.Core/bin/Release/net471/Fika.Core.dll /mnt/server/Dedicated-Client/BepInEx/plugins
mv tmp/Fika-Dedicated/Fika.Dedicated/bin/Release/net471/Fika.Dedicated.dll /mnt/server/Dedicated-Client/BepInEx/plugins

echo -e "${GREEN}install complete!"
